elements.note: A white thumbs-up icon, right above the button.
A red SUBSCRIBE button (white bold text), dead centre.
A white hand cursor that moves onto the button and clicks it.

note: The CTA is a small animated sticker over the story, not a separate end card: the footage keeps playing behind it, darkened. Thumbs-up, button, then the cursor clicking it: the viewer is shown the action, not told. The line of text at the bottom of the original frame is the player's own captions, not part of the video.
